Messages.Author: reyda
Messages.Body:
Hi !
a quick question about those multi discipline cards.
Giotto , before range is chosen plays 4xIncreased stength. Then announces
his strike : conflagration. Does the conflagration inflict 6 aggravated
damage ?
thanks !
reyda

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


If he plays it as a potence strike, it deals 6R non-agg damage.
If he plays it as a normal daimonion strike, it deals 1R aggravated damage (Increased
Strength doesn't boost strikes that don't require Potence).
If he plays it as a superior daimonion strike, it deals 2R aggravated damage.
